description: This file defines the core domain class 'Obs' which models a single clinical observation in the OpenMRS healthcare system. It includes properties for patient reference, concept, value, metadata, hierarchical groupings, as well as methods for managing these observations, converting values to/from strings, and handling complex data. The class supports features such as versioning, querying, and group relationships, and is heavily annotated for Hibernate and auditing purposes.

classes.name: Obs
classes.description: Core domain class representing a clinical observation, supporting hierarchical groupings, value conversions, versioning, and metadata annotations for persistence and auditing.

methods.name: getValueAsString
methods.description: Returns the observation's value formatted as a string, considering the concept's datatype and localization, including support for complex data and groupings.

methods.name: setValueAsString
methods.description: Parses and sets the observation's value from a string input, considering the concept's datatype.

methods.name: addGroupMember
methods.description: Adds an observation as a member of this group, establishing hierarchical relationships.

methods.name: removeGroupMember
methods.description: Removes a specified observation from this group's members.

methods.name: hasGroupMembers
methods.description: Checks whether this observation has any group members, optionally including voided ones.
